variants.specifics: Brackenford: Three townsfolk: a grumble about the times, a brush-off, gossip about Red Corwin.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Wolves in the woods, Urchins in the barrow, bandits on the hill! What did we ever do to deserve this?

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Can't stop, dear, the bread's in the oven!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: They say Red Corwin once robbed a whole wagon train with nothing but a stick and a very loud voice!

variants.specifics: Kroth: Three miners of Kroth: Bettina pushing her ore cart, Tamsin whose husband won't go below, Olf with word of Edda's trouble.

rumour1.speaker: Bettina
rumour1.text: Out of my way! This cart won't push itself!

rumour2.speaker: Tamsin
rumour2.text: My husband won't go below anymore. He swears he saw his dead uncle down there, still swinging a pick!

rumour3.speaker: Olf
rumour3.text: Old Edda's been screaming about Urchins all morning. Somebody ought to help her.

variants.specifics: Gloam: Three townsfolk of Gloam: Nell brushes the player off, Haskin worries about the bog, Hollis gossips about the Mayor.

rumour1.speaker: Nell
rumour1.text: Not now, please. My floor's flooding again.

rumour2.speaker: Haskin
rumour2.text: I feel it in my bones. Something terrible is coming up out of that bog, and nobody's doing a thing about it!

rumour3.speaker: Hollis
rumour3.text: Mayor Grimbol hasn't set foot outside the Town Hall in a week. They say he sleeps under his desk with a pitchfork!

variants.specifics: Durnhelm: Gaspar brags about the Commander, Agna frets about the Necromancer, Bodric brushes the player off.

rumour1.speaker: Gaspar
rumour1.text: Commander Holgrim is the bravest man in Durnhelm! He once wrestled an Ogre in the courtyard and won!

rumour2.speaker: Agna
rumour2.text: They say the Necromancer can raise a whole army out of the mud on Kragmoor. I haven't slept a wink in days!

rumour3.speaker: Bodric
rumour3.text: What? Sorry, I've got bread in the oven.

variants.specifics: Ostra: Three villagers of Ostra: Dorrie gutting eels, Mungo the fisherman, Pell on the pier.

rumour1.speaker: Dorrie
rumour1.text: Not now! I've got a whole basket of eels to skin.

rumour2.speaker: Mungo
rumour2.text: I've seen dead men walking in the shallows! Dead men! Who's going to buy fish out of a lake full of dead men?

rumour3.speaker: Pell
rumour3.text: Mayor Odrick hasn't set foot outside his house since the dead came up. Some mayor!

variants.specifics: Ardoth: Three townsfolk: Fennick brushes the player off, Tessaly gossips about Malgor, Pim frets about the Skeletons.

rumour1.speaker: Fennick
rumour1.text: Not now, stranger. I've got my own troubles.

rumour2.speaker: Tessaly
rumour2.text: Malgor was a student here once, you know. They threw him out of the College for raising the cook's cat from the dead!

rumour3.speaker: Pim
rumour3.text: Every night there are more Skeletons on the road. How long can the College hold out?

variants.specifics: Fort Skarn: Ulla, Grindle and Fitch, folk of Fort Skarn.

rumour1.speaker: Ulla
rumour1.text: Cold, cold, cold! I haven't felt my toes since spring.

rumour2.speaker: Grindle
rumour2.text: Warden Brannoc hasn't slept a wink since the Undead came down the pass. Poor man looks worse than they do!

rumour3.speaker: Fitch
rumour3.text: Nibbs is in the cell again for cheating at dice. He'll talk your ear off if you let him.

variants.specifics: Vulmar: Three townsfolk of Vulmar: Pell at the bellows, Orla, and old Brom.

rumour1.speaker: Pell
rumour1.text: Can't talk now. These bellows won't pump themselves!

rumour2.speaker: Orla
rumour2.text: Mayor Dravik hasn't slept a wink since the Ogres came down off the mountain. I hear him pacing up and down all night long!

rumour3.speaker: Brom
rumour3.text: Keep your purse tied tight, stranger. The Imps will grab anything that shines.

variants.specifics: Kesrin: Three folk of Kesrin: Wenzel brushes the player off, Bettrin frets about Ravek and the caravans, Lumm warns about the Imps.

rumour1.speaker: Wenzel
rumour1.text: What? Can't you see I'm busy?

rumour2.speaker: Bettrin
rumour2.text: Merchants used to stop here every day of the week. Ever since Ravek and his Undead came to Fort Karn, nobody travels the east road anymore! What will become of us?

rumour3.speaker: Lumm
rumour3.text: Going south? Keep your purse tied tight. The Imps of Gallow Rock will take anything that shines!

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Three villagers: Nettie the milkmaid, old Bram, and Joss the farmhand.

rumour1.speaker: Nettie
rumour1.text: The Ogres ate my best milking cow! I cried for a week.

rumour2.speaker: Bram
rumour2.text: Mayor Bellock hasn't slept a wink since the Ogres came. They say he keeps a pitchfork under his bed!

rumour3.speaker: Joss
rumour3.text: Can't stop to chat, stranger. Those turnips won't pick themselves!
